subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` the canonical Chinese locale IDs across Control UI, CLI wizard, docs publishing, saved browser preferences, and app locale mappings?
rationale: The rename is technically coherent, but it changes shipped public locale identifiers, documented CLI environment values, and persisted browser preferences, so automation should not choose the migration and alias policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve coordinated migration
options.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates runtime, docs, generated artifacts, tests, and old-value handling together.

options.title: Keep region-code public IDs
options.body: Leave `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` as OpenClaw's public runtime and CLI IDs while accepting script-form input only as aliases that resolve to the existing IDs.

options.title: Split docs metadata from runtime IDs
options.body: Keep runtime and CLI IDs unchanged while limiting script-based naming to docs publish metadata and navigation internals.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated migration
recommendation.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates runtime, docs, generated artifacts, tests, and old-value handling together.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the broadest routing owner from the current history because the choice crosses setup/docs compatibility policy rather than one generated locale file.
